card.name: Word-initial T inside compound words
card.fires_on: A word-start or hyphen-joined 't' piece inside a compound, such as 'water-tight', 'air-tight', 'Sun-Times', 'DROP-TAINER' or 'SYRINGE TIP'. It marks the point where the next piece begins with t.

modes.label: -tight compounds
modes.description: The 't' or 'ert' piece completing watertight or airtight.
modes.example: close the dura in a water<<-t>>ight fashion.

modes.label: Brand or name compounds
modes.description: A hyphenated or capitalised T piece in a product or newspaper name.
modes.example: update from the Chicago Sun<<-T>>imes, which has done an amazing job

modes.label: Other t-starting words
modes.description: A 't' piece starting a regular word, such as trombone or tenth.

card.writes: It suppresses 'trace' and related tokens, and promotes 'charge' words, so it has no clear link to the t-word being built.
card.plain: It fires where a compound word is split and the next piece starts with t, as in water-tight.
